changeSet.sql: CREATE FUNCTION audio_result_search_vector(result bytea) RETURNS tsvector LANGUAGE sql STABLE STRICT AS $$ SELECT to_tsvector( 'pg_catalog.russian', jsonb_path_query_array(document, '$.transcript.segments[*].text') || COALESCE(document -> 'analysis', 'null'::jsonb) ) FROM (SELECT convert_from(result, 'UTF8')::jsonb AS document) AS parsed $$
